unresolved: order screenshot has no visible quantity, so position size is unknown
stop level never stated as an absolute price; 'Trailing full' describes a trailing-stop mechanism without a number
'10% up from Entry' is an interim unrealized gain on an open position, not a stated final result -- not recorded as net_result_pct
'These Quickly Risk Free Trades' reads as a general description of this trade archetype, not an unambiguous statement that this specific stop was moved to breakeven
attached chart images carry 'E' entry markers and percentage callouts with no explicit numeric price label attached to them

notes: Post text is only '#FCL', '#FCL Almost at the 10% circuit now...', and '#FCL - 10% up from Entry...'; no post text states a price. The root post's readable broker order confirmation explicitly records a successful Fineotex Chemical buy at Price 39.05, so that visible fill is the cited entry evidence.
The order confirmation also displays LTP 40.75, which is transcribed as last_price evidence only. It does not state quantity, a stop, or a target.

'10% up from Entry' is deliberately NOT net_result_pct: net_result_pct is defined as the trade's stated result, and this position is still open ('Trailing full' = full size still held, no exit stated anywhere in the thread). An interim unrealized-gain mention on an open position is commentary, not a result.

'These Quickly Risk Free Trades' is genuine, defensible-either-way ambiguity: it could mean 'this specific FCL stop is now at breakeven' (as in the Fastzonetrader fixture's unambiguous 'Everything risk free now'), or it could be a general remark about this trader's preferred trade archetype ('these [kind of] quickly-risk-free trades'). Given the ambiguity and the ban on inferring an unstated number anyway (no absolute stop price exists to record even if the move were certain), this was left out of `stop` and recorded in `unresolved` instead.
